units.source_text: 那头发一根一根的拔下来时，家将的心里，恐怖也一点一点的消去了。

en.t: As the hairs were pulled out one by one, the fear in the servant's heart faded little by little.

units.source_text: 而且同时，对于这老妪的憎恶，也渐渐的发动了。

en.t: At the same time, hatred for the old woman gradually began to stir within him.

units.source_text: ——不，说是“对于这老妪”，或者有些语病；

en.t: No, to say it was hatred for this old woman may not be quite accurate;

units.source_text: 倒不如说，对于一切恶的反感，一点一点的强盛起来了。

en.t: rather, his revulsion against all evil was growing stronger little by little.

units.source_text: 这时候，倘有人向了这家将，提出这人先前在门下面所想的“饿死呢还是做强盗呢”这一个问题来，

en.t: At that moment, if someone had put to the servant the question he had earlier considered under the gate, whether to starve to death or become a robber,

units.source_text: 大约这家将是，便毫无留恋，拣了饿死的了。

en.t: the servant would probably have chosen starvation without the slightest hesitation.

units.source_text: 这人的恶恶之心，宛如那老妪插在楼板缝中的松明一般，

en.t: This man's hatred of evil was like the pine torch the old woman had thrust into the crack between the floorboards,

units.source_text: 蓬蓬勃勃的燃烧上来，已经到如此。

en.t: blazing up with such force that it had already reached this intensity.
